Question papers shall be in both Odia and English versions; candidates must choose their medium while filling the online application form (option once given cannot be changed). || Stage 1 - Preliminary Examination (Objective Type) || Negative marking: 0.25 marks for each wrong answer. A minimum of 5 times the number of vacancies (post-wise and category-wise) shall be shortlisted for Main Written Examination. If vacancies in any post/category are less than 10, then candidates numbering 10 times the vacancies shall be shortlisted. || Stage 2 - Main Written Examination (Technical Paper) || Stage 3 - Certificate Verification
syllabus: 1 Technical Paper (syllabus as per Annexure-D of notification; Technical Paper for Junior Draughtsman (Civil) and Tracer will be the same) 200 Marks 2 hours (120 minutes) Different papers for different posts. Candidates numbering 1.5 times the advertised vacancies (post-wise and category-wise) shall be shortlisted for Certificate Verification. Negative marking: 1/4 of total mark (4 options) or 1/3 of total mark (3 options)

title: Guest Faculty
qualification: Any Post Graduate, M.Phil/ Ph.D
salary: Rs. 1,000/- per class (with Ph.D., max 60 classes); Rs. 750/- per class (without Ph.D., max 60 classes)
age_limit: All Posts: Retired Faculty may continue till 70 years of age.
